_comment: FL-155 [Rev. January 1, 2004] is the simplified financial statement a parent may use instead of FL-150 when the only support asked for is child support and every eligibility question on its page 2 is No (not self-employed, no spousal support or lawyer's fees asked by either side, income only from welfare, salary or wages, disability, unemployment, interest, workers' compensation, social security or retirement). That screening is asked in DV-100 (DV-570), never here. Every field is the filer's except the case number (the clerk's), the second and third lines of the TELEPHONE NO. column and item 13 (blank by design), and the on-screen notices and buttons. FL-150 and FL-155 are never in one packet, and FL-150's sections are switched off when FL-155 is on, so everything only FL-155 asks is fl155_*; names are shared only with answers DV-100 or DV-105 asks every FL-155 filer: the filer's name, street address, city, state, ZIP code and phone, the lawyer's name and firm, the person to be restrained, the court's street address, and the children (dv105_child, the count of DV-105's children block, as FL-150 item 16a). Four fields are one AcroForm field with several boxes told apart by export value - item 4's tax status (/Yes single, /1 jointly, /2 head of household, /3 separately), item 8g (/Yes rent, /No mortgage), item 9 (/Yes current, /No most recent) and the declarant role under the signature (/Yes petitioner, /1 respondent). Each is named for its first box, the only one pdf-lib's check() can tick, and is computed (the hints): the tax, housing and work choices are asked with options of their own, and the first box ticks when its option is chosen. The declarant box ticks on DV-100's child support answer, which every FL-155 filer has given - the filer asking for protection is the petitioner. Rows were read from the rectangles and a tagged test fill, not the XFA names: item 5's amounts run 0b (salary), then retirement, unemployment, workers' compensation, social security, disability and interest; the unnamed field under 3c at x=61 is 3c's second ruled line.
